summary: Collect and assess current evidence that a specific candidate satisfies its required checks.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Exact candidate, scope, changed surfaces, and implementation claims.

inputs.name: test-plan
inputs.description: Required checks, expected observations, environments, and evidence requirements.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Authoritative criteria for resolving verification ambiguity.

completion_checks: Every required check has a recorded result on the identified candidate.
Passing checks reference substantive execution evidence.
Missing, skipped, stale, and failed checks cannot be reported as passed.
failure_modes: A required check observes incorrect behavior: failed.
A required runtime, capability, or fixture is unavailable: blocked.
No meaningful checks ran or evidence is stale or ambiguous: inconclusive.
